announcements.headline: Proposed capital reduction
announcements.insight: A proposed capital reduction is a corporate action that typically alters the share structure by returning capital to shareholders or adjusting nominal values. While it can signal financial restructuring or efficiency improvements, it is generally considered a routine governance matter unless accompanied by specific details on value or purpose.
